name: security-scan
on: [push]
jobs:
  sast:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@a1e078f8b3b8b1e1cb4a5a7c1c93e5e6b7f8c9d0
      - uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@b2e178f9c4a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1
        continue-on-error: true

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@a1e078f8b3b8b1e1cb4a5a7c1c93e5e6b7f8c9d0
      - uses: anchore/scan-action@d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3
        continue-on-error: true
supporting_context: All scan findings are routed to a security dashboard only; no written remediation SLA exists; no scanner result has ever failed a build
expected_action: Remove continue-on-error from all scanner steps and establish a written remediation SLA with blocking severity gates

ground_truth.detail: Both SAST and SCA scanners run with continue-on-error: true and route findings to a dashboard only; security program is decorative, not enforcing

config_snippet:
name: release
on:
  push:
    tags: ['v*']
jobs:
  build-sign:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: read
      packages: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@f1e5b4c3d2a19087654321fedcba0987654321fe
      - uses: azure/login@a1e078f8b3b8b1e1cb4a5a7c1c93e5e6b7f8c9d0
        with:
          client-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          tenant-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          subscription-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}
      - run: docker buildx build --sbom=true --provenance=true -t myimage:${{ github.sha }} .
      - uses: sigstore/cosign-installer@abc123def456abc123def456abc123def456abc1
      - run: cosign sign --yes myimage:${{ github.sha }}
supporting_context: All dependency manifests use commit-SHA pinning; cosign verify gate blocks promotion; OIDC token used for cloud auth; no static credentials in any workflow
expected_action: No action required; OIDC federation, SHA-pinned actions, cosign artifact signing, and SBOM provenance are all in place

ground_truth.detail: Full enforcement posture: OIDC federation, commit-SHA-pinned actions, cosign signing, SBOM/provenance attestation, no static credentials
